claim_boundary: Every number in this artifact is an inverse requirement or an assumption screen; none is an achieved OpenTallas result.
The DeepSeek/B300 thresholds and local Qwen measurement are separate because they do not execute the same checkpoint.
Public ROM-density and bandwidth anchors do not validate an N4 ROM compiler, PVT margin, simultaneous-array power, or manufacturability.
A generic FP8 ceiling is not evidence that the exact FP8, MXFP4 x FP8, FP4, BF16, and FP32 operation mix is implemented.
Strict performance superiority requires same-model measurement above the equality threshold with accuracy, latency, context, batch, concurrency, power scope, and software stack controlled.

comparison_contract.arithmetic: exact per-format operation requirements retained; no integer-RTL substitution
comparison_contract.power_semantics: published/derived DGX B300 system allocated power divided by eight; not measured GPU-board power
comparison_contract.speedup_semantics: 1.0x is equality; higher performance requires measured throughput strictly above the threshold under the same model, context, batch, latency, accuracy, and power scope

infeasible_reasons: C7/C8: 32 resident users required (batch 32 x 1 stages) exceeds capacity 26
excluded_comparator_points.reason: comparator point is infeasible in its own governed capacity model

local_qwen_measurement.comparison_use: separate local Qwen service target only; never substituted for the DeepSeek/B300 inverse thresholds
